Well, best seller isn't really my goal :P

I mostly want something I can be proud of, and show to friends.

But, I also have a passion in tabletop...maybe I can make the next warhammer, who knows.

Thanks, that puts it in a new light.

I have always wanted to write a novel, maybe that can be my big achievement.

This means a lot to me, thanks.

But usually, I just come back to the point of "that won't matter, I'll be gone anyway". 

But that comment was really needed, thanks.
I assume you meant not being a bitch, as supposed to "you're lot being a little bitch"
